bankCorrections.review: Re-read only the native OS eastern Channelsea bank at Victoria/Corn/Caledonian and Langthorn/Abbey chemical walls. Twelve existing controls corrected; opposite-bank controls, ring length, river terminals and every other existing river retained. These are solid shaded riverside ranges, not over-water roofs. No building trimming or blanket water exception.
